note: Task-call agent (ADR-500, docs/decisions/calls.md). Our server places the Twilio call and connects it with register-call, passing the variables compiled from the approved brief (server/messaging/src/taskCalls/payload.ts). Created by server/messaging/scripts/setup-task-call-agent.mjs; the server's drift check compares the live agent with server/messaging/src/taskCalls/agentSpec.ts, which voice_agent_spec.py keeps in step with this folder.

variables.doddy_opening_line: AI disclosure + the question, spoken word for word (server-built)
variables.doddy_principal: the user's first name in the genitive
variables.doddy_facts: only the facts the user ticked, one per line
variables.doddy_attempt: attempt id for matching the post-call webhook; not used in the prompt

placeholders.doddy_opening_line: Dzień dobry, mówi Doddy, asystent AI, dzwonię w imieniu Anny. Chciałbym zapytać: Czy laptop z serwisu jest gotowy?
placeholders.doddy_question: Czy laptop z serwisu jest gotowy?
placeholders.doddy_goal: Dowiedzieć się, czy laptop oddany do naprawy jest gotowy do odbioru.
placeholders.doddy_callback_line: Sprawdzę to u Anny i oddzwonię.

privacy.note: Transcripts are deleted by our server right after processing; one day is the backstop.
